beta.basis: Independent channels are stipulated; zero common-cause contribution is assumed only for this example.

halfway_s.basis: Synthetic sample instant at half of the stipulated seating time.

lambda_per_hour.basis: Synthetic constant dangerous-undetected rate in p(t)=lambda*t; assumed.

loaded_speed_m_s.basis: Synthetic constant loaded travel speed; assumed, not measured.

proof_interval_h.basis: Synthetic averaging interval; perfect reset and no repair within the interval are assumed.

rangeability.basis: Synthetic equal-percentage conductance ratio; assumed, not an installed-flow characteristic.

seating_s.basis: Synthetic seating instant, independently obtained by distance divided by speed.

equal_percentage_half.basis: [H] Stipulated normalized conductance law; seating is a separate boundary rule.
equal_percentage_half.label: Equal percentage half
equal_percentage_half.method: Remaining fraction R^(-t/T) before seating. At or after seating the API returns exact zero.

equal_percentage_seated.basis: [H] Stipulated normalized conductance law; seating is a separate boundary rule.
equal_percentage_seated.label: Equal percentage seated
equal_percentage_seated.method: Remaining fraction R^(-t/T) before seating. At or after seating the API returns exact zero.

independent_average.label: Independent dual-channel average
independent_average.method: Integral of (lambda*t)^2 over the interval, divided by interval length; beta is zero.

linear_half.basis: [H] Stipulated normalized conductance law; seating is a separate boundary rule.
linear_half.label: Linear half
linear_half.method: Remaining fraction 1-t/T. At or after seating the API returns exact zero.

linear_seated.basis: [H] Stipulated normalized conductance law; seating is a separate boundary rule.
linear_seated.label: Linear seated
linear_seated.method: Remaining fraction 1-t/T. At or after seating the API returns exact zero.

reciprocal.basis: [H] Reciprocal of 1/200; no system-level risk reduction established.
reciprocal.label: Reciprocal of single-channel average
reciprocal.method: Reciprocal of the single-channel time average.

single_average.label: Single-channel average
single_average.method: Integral of lambda*t over the interval, divided by interval length.
